verdict.rationale: Stripe's platform-wide MCP server lets AI agents call the general Stripe API and search docs, and Stripe advertises 'agent-first developer tools,' but no evidence specifically shows natural-language control of Terminal (in-person payment/reader) operations rather than generic Stripe API usage. Missing for 10: Terminal-specific MCP tools or docs showing an agent issuing NL commands to readers, and hands-on/community confirmation that Terminal actions (charge, refund, reader management) can be driven conversationally.
